page_title: ELC 4-0 RAY | Elche v Rayo Vallecano 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+1' 4 - 0 Goal! Josan finds Martim Neto (Elche) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the right side of the goal. Fantasy football! 4:0.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
89' Substitution. Adam Boayar (Elche) has come on for Rafa Mir.
87' A snap shot by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Inaki Pena produces a good save to thwart him.
86' None of the Rayo Vallecano players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
84' The foul by Josan (Elche) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Adrian Cordero.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano). Adrian Cordero doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
80' Substitution. Pedro Bigas is replaced by Leo Petrot (Elche).
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Josan (Elche) coming on for Marc Aguado.
80' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Alvaro Rodriguez and he is replaced by Yago Santiago (Elche).
79' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Aleix Febas (Elche) for a tough tackle.
78' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Inaki Pena (Elche).
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Unai Lopez.
75' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Jozhua Vertrouwd (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Pacha.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luiz Felipe (Rayo Vallecano) will replace Nobel Mendy.
74' The foul by Rafa Mir (Elche) was seen by Adrian Cordero who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
73' Martim Neto (Elche) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
70' 3 - 0 German Valera (Elche) receives a precise pass inside the box from Alvaro Rodriguez and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the right side of the net. 3:0.

67' 2 - 0 Pedro Bigas is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the goal to make the score 2:0.
65' David Affengruber (Elche) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
64' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes.
61' Rafa Mir (Elche) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Augusto Batalla makes a great save to stop his effort.
60' Oscar Valentin comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).

55' CHANCE! Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.

54' That didn't go as planned! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Inaki Pena, who easily kept it out.
52' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
52' German Valera (Elche) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Elche.
51' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
50' A cross into the box picks out Rafa Mir (Elche), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
48' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
47' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
47' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+256' The referee interrupts the game and gives a red card to Federico Redondo Solari (Elche). He can take an early bath.
46' The whistle blows and Adrian Cordero starts the second half.
45+4' Federico Redondo Solari (Elche) is given a red card for some unsportsmanlike conduct off the pitch.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Elche can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Flag up against Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
42' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
41' Elche take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
39' A clumsy foul by German Valera (Elche) and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
36' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
33' Ivan Balliu is substituted due to injury. Inigo Perez gives a chance to Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
32' Looks like Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
31' Great chance! Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
28' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

28' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the resulting free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper dives to his right and denies the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that. Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.

26' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Inaki Pena is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Elche comes to nothing.
24' Rafa Mir (Elche) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly. The referee signals a corner kick to Elche.
22' Adrian Cordero shows the yellow card to Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) for a heavy challenge.
22' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' The ball is cleared after German Valera (Elche) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
13' Poor challenge! Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for tripping and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle.
12' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.
12' Eder Sarabia is forced to make a change. Hector Fort is unable to continue due to injury, Martim Neto (Elche) comes on.
10' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Inaki Pena stops the ball from going inside the left post.
7' Hector Fort (Elche) picks up an injury.
6' 1 - 0 Hector Fort (Elche) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Augusto Batalla with a strike under the crossbar. He makes it 1:0.
5' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
4' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) dribbles into the box, but Inaki Pena is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
2' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside!
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Elche will have the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
